IC1: - Adult (18 years of age or older) [AND] with the diagnosis of essential thrombocytosis, [OR] prefibrotic myelofibrosis [OR] or overt myelofibrosis according to WHO 2016 criteria;
IC2: - Patient who has [NOT] not received specific treatment for neoplasms;
IC3: - Patient who has signed the consent to participate in the study;
IC4: - Patient who has consented to be included in the "Malignant Haemopathies" collection at the University Hospital of Angers [OR] or Brest and for whom the samples necessary for the study are available in the biocollection.
